answer: Admission is serialized: each epoch the ledger opens only a narrow inlet of new identities. A candidate must post a unique work artifact and gather three co-witnesses from distinct funding clusters; those sightings are hash-linked in a public grove. If two applicants reuse the same artifact or share a funding graph, both bonds and the last five epochs of rewards are slashed. Honest agents still earn in the open meadow of tasks, but extra names cannot multiply votes faster than the inlet allows.
